frontFaq.q: Is this a course or a tool?
frontFaq.a: This page is the Content AI System. You fill a brief, copy a prompt, and paste it into your own AI tool. It is not the course on promptanatomy.app. The paid kits are PDFs you download, not another login.
Yes. 14-day no-questions refund. Reply to your Stripe receipt or email info@promptanatomy.app. We approve through Stripe and revoke the download link.

frontFaq.q: What does the team license cover?
frontFaq.a: One in-house marketing team at one company. CMO + 1–4 directs, or one CMO equivalent. Print and share within that team. No agency, multi-brand, or training-resale rights without a separate license.

frontFaq.q: Will my data be sold or shared?
frontFaq.a: No. Stripe processes payment and Resend delivers the email — we store no marketing list and do not add you to one. Post-purchase tips are transactional only. See our privacy page.

buyerFaq.q: How and when do I get my PDF?
buyerFaq.a: Pay through Stripe. Within 5 minutes you receive an email from info@promptanatomy.app with signed download link(s). Bundle buyers receive separate links for Starter and Pro. If email does not arrive, contact us and we will resend.

buyerFaq.q: How is this different from the free library?
buyerFaq.a: The free library lets you use the system in your browser, including the Creative brief builder for image-ready prompts. The kits add depth and team assets: offline and printable, with worked examples, full prompt bodies (Pro), scenario plays, a safety reviewer, a 90-minute workshop, and — in Pro — a method for building your own reusable workflows and tools. You buy the system depth and the team license, not just a PDF.

buyerFaq.q: Is the PDF a live app?
buyerFaq.a: No. PDF is the delivery format for the content operating system — offline, printable, workshop-ready. There is no login or hosted dashboard.
